de: The record low unemployment rate, close to 2.2%, will persist in Russia for at least the next year. This forecast was voiced by the first Deputy Chairman of the Duma Committee on labor Svetlana Bessarab.

de: Fraudsters on behalf of the Federal Tax Service (FTS) send notifications about the alleged need to check tax accruals with reference to a fake website. This was reported by the official representative of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Russia Irina Volk on October 16.

te: Russian Security Council: West uses dependence on digital solutions to achieve its goals
de: The West uses its digital solutions as a tool to achieve geopolitical goals. This was stated by Deputy Secretary of the Security Council of the Russian Federation Alexey Shevtsov at a conference on security in Central Asia and Afghanistan.

te: Grossi: The shortage of diesel fuel at the NPP poses a threat to nuclear safety
de: The shortage of diesel fuel at the Zaporizhia nuclear power plant poses a threat to nuclear safety, said the Director General of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) Rafael Grossi.

de: Issues of social protection of platform workers require a comprehensive study and balanced solutions, said Ekaterina Gribkova, a member of the Federation Council Committee on Social Policy.

de: The Russian military took full control of the Volchansk-Budarki highway in the Kharkiv region, along which the Ukrainian Armed Forces tried to lay logistics routes. This was reported on October 16 in the Ministry of Defense of the Russian Federation.

d: В 2027 году предусмотрено продление всех востребованных программ содействия занятости. Об этом сообщил глава Минтруда России Антон Котяков на заседании Комитета Госдумы по бюджету и налогам 16 октября.
te: The Ministry of labor: in 2027 will extend all popular programs to promote employment
de: In 2027, it is planned to extend all the programs of employment promotion in demand. This was announced by the head of the Ministry of labor of Russia Anton Kotyakov at a meeting of the Duma Committee on budget and taxes on October 16.

d: Единый мерзлотный центр планируется создать на базе МГУ. Орган будет разрабатывать новые технологии, регламенты и стандарты, необходимые для обеспечения геотехнической безопасности домов в условиях таяния вечной мерзлоты.
te: Russia plans to create a single permafrost center on the basis of MSU
de: A single permafrost center is planned to be created on the basis of MSU. The body will develop new technologies, regulations and standards necessary to ensure the geotechnical safety of homes in conditions of melting permafrost.

t: Росгидромет: До конца года откроются 20 новых пунктов мониторинга вечной мерзлоты
d: До конца 2026 года на Севере и Дальнем Востоке планируется организовать 20 новых пунктов наблюдений для фонового мониторинга многолетней мерзлоты. Об этом заявил представитель Росгидромета Сергей Мартынов.
te: Roshydromet: By the end of the year will open 20 new monitoring points permafrost
de: By the end of 2026, it is planned to organize 20 new observation points for background monitoring of permafrost in the North and the Far East. This was stated by the representative of Roshydromet Sergey Martynov.

t: Сенатор Пушкарев оценил ущерб от таяния мерзлоты в триллионы рублей
d: Деградация вечной мерзлоты несет колоссальные экономические риски для российской Арктики. В стратегической перспективе прогнозные потери от растепления грунтов по всей стране могут достичь 3-4 триллионов рублей.
te: Senator Pushkarev estimated the damage from melting permafrost in trillions of rubles
de: Permafrost degradation poses enormous economic risks to the Russian Arctic. In the strategic perspective, the projected losses from soil warming throughout the country can reach 3-4 trillion rubles.
